title: CR-BRK-007 — WO Lines Edit with WO View OFF — implicit dependency gap
preconds: WO View \u2717 | WO Lines E \u2713 | View Mode: Full (attempt to configure/save) (View Mode as specified).
steps:
1. Configure a custom role per the Setup in Preconditions; assign to a test user and log in.
  2. Try to reach a WO line; observe login/landing behavior.
expected:
WO Lines View is inherited from WO View (§1b: no independent View toggle). With WO View OFF, WO nav is hidden and lines are unreachable; WOL Edit must be inert. Ideally the editor prevents/cascades this state.

Risk / Rationale: WOL Edit ON while WO View OFF → Access Restricted or broken state (known defect).
Spec Ref: §1b WO Lines (View inherited from WO View)
